verdict.rationale: decK is documented as a CLI for declarative 'API Lifecycle Automation' that syncs/orchestrates configuration across an entire Kong setup, which implies bulk create/update/delete across many entities (services, routes, plugins) at once rather than one-by-one Admin API calls. However, no evidence explicitly demonstrates bulk operations at scale, batch APIs, or hands-on confirmation of this workflow for AI-native/agent use cases. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk changes, and AI-agent-specific bulk operation examples.
